## Change

Explain the problem and resulting behavior.

## Validation

List tests and, for UI changes, remote-navigation checks.

- [ ] No credentials, private URLs or personal media.
- [ ] New assets have documented source, license and manifest checksums.
- [ ] Screenshots use original or appropriately licensed demo content.
- [ ] GPL and third-party notices are preserved.
- [ ] User-facing documentation reflects the final behavior.
